reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas and Municipal Council) due to reasons such as non-attendance, death, and resignation. It involves the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically Section 66 A(1), which governs how vacancies in elected local government offices are filled through nominations by recognized political parties. The content focuses on electoral procedures and declarations of elected members rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or any other specialized administrative matters.
